finding: Interest rate tightening for Slovak firms rose sharply to a net 43.8%
bullets: A net 43.8% of Slovak firms (n=76) reported tighter interest rates in wave 39, rising 38.3 pp from a net 5.5% in wave 38, exceeding the EA's net 40.0% and Germany's net 42.5%.
Credit line and loan size availability tightened further, with a net 12.4% of Slovak firms (n=74) reporting a reduction, up 6.3 pp from net 6.1% in wave 38.
Loan maturity tightened for a net 11.6% of Slovak firms (n=76), well above the EA's net 4.4% and Germany's net 3.4%.
chart_subtitle: Net 43.8% of Slovak firms reported tighter interest rates.
